rca_of_issue: subscription.py create-order and subscribe endpoints had hardcoded plan validation ('pro' or 'elite') which was written before the plan restructure. After plan names changed to 'starter' and 'pro', the validation was not updated, causing 400 errors when subscribing to Starter plan. Fix: updated all 3 subscription endpoints to accept ('starter', 'pro', 'elite') and updated bonus_credits mapping.
